management_remarks: During Q2 FY26, Jio Platforms crossed 495 million subscribers with robust enterprise cloud and AI service adoption driving digital EBITDA margins above 53%. Reliance Retail completed its store network optimization and delivered accelerated same-store sales growth of 11.8% with expanding operating margins. Consolidated Net Debt-to-EBITDA improved further as operating cash flows comfortably outpaced moderating capex.
analyst_qa: Addressing questions on minority stake valuations and holding company discounts, capital market sentiment toward conglomerates can be volatile and uncertain. While retail store rationalization is largely complete, B2B kirana credit growth is moderating under cautious working capital controls. Export fuel realizations remain challenging and subject to fluctuating global refining utilization.
